c-anon-invite-landing.1.evidence: Fixture invite to Amsterdam Chapter: guest page "You've been invited to join Amsterdam Chapter", description, "Log in to accept invite"; with users_can_register briefly set to 1 the page also had "Create free account" (register link with redirect_to); option restored to 0. Member count stayed 3.

c-anon-invite-landing.2.evidence: Guest login link is wp-login.php?redirect_to=<invite URL>; after logging in as bob the browser returns to the invite page showing "Join Space"; member count still 3. (Login done through the autologin helper, not typed credentials.)

c-anon-invite-landing.3.evidence: bob clicked Join Space: POST to the invite URL with jt_invite_nonce, landed on /community/s/amsterdam-chapter/; space members 3 -> 4, bob row present, invite use_count 1. bob later removed to restore 3.

c-anon-invite-landing.4.evidence: bob reopened the same invite: "You are already a member of Amsterdam Chapter." plus "Go to Space"; two more GETs left members at 4 with one bob row.

c-anon-invite-landing.5.evidence: bob GET x2 and HEAD on a valid invite: wp_jt_space_members count 3 before and after.

c-anon-invite-landing.6.evidence: Form POST without jt_invite_nonce as bob: not joined (count 3|3); REST POST /invite/<token> without X-WP-Nonce -> 401 rest_not_logged_in, count unchanged.

c-anon-invite-landing.7.evidence: With registration off (site default) guest sees only "Log in to accept invite", no Create free account.

c-anon-invite-landing.9.evidence: Expired fixture (expires_at 2 days ago): guest and bob get 410 "This invite link has expired or reached its usage limit.", no Join button.

c-anon-invite-landing.10.evidence: Fixture with max_uses 1 / use_count 1: bob gets 410 with the same limit message and no Join button.

c-anon-invite-landing.11.evidence: Invite to archived 2025 Hackathon as non-members theo, maya, hana, alice: "This space is archived or locked and is not taking new members.", no Join (bob already a member of it so shows already-member).

c-anon-invite-landing.12.evidence: omar on Off-Topic Lounge invite: "You have been banned from this space and cannot take part in it."; forced form POST with valid nonce shows the same, REST POST -> 403 jetonomy_user_space_banned; space count stayed 20. Space ban (id 699) is a re-created seed fixture.

c-anon-invite-landing.13.evidence: One-use invite, alice and maya POST at the same time (threads): space members 4 -> 5, only maya added; invite use_count 1; alice sees the 410 limit page afterwards.

c-anon-invite-landing.14.evidence: 390px dark: invite page action button 328px wide (full width), heading rgb(229,229,229) on rgb(35,38,47), no horizontal scroll.

c-anon-invite-landing.15.evidence: Guest on Moderators Room invite: names the space and its one-line description plus "Log in to accept invite" (invite holder), shows no members or topics, no sidebar data.

c-anon-invite-landing.16.evidence: Well-formed unknown 32-char token -> HTTP 404 "Invalid invite link." (no longer a soft 200).

c-anon-invite-landing.17.evidence: omar has a member row in Off-Topic Lounge; his invite page says he is banned instead of redirecting into the space.

c-anon-invite-landing.18.evidence: Existing member opening an invite to his space gets "You are already a member of ..." with a Go to Space link, no redirect; runbook text that the code silently redirects is out of date.
